subject: [RFC PATCH v3 1/8] mm/gup: break out gup_fill_pages() helper

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch breaks out a helper function called gup_fill_pages() from the __get_user_pages() function in mm/gup.c. The new helper function fills pages[] and flushes each page's caches, which can then be used by other parts of the code that need to access multiple pages at once. This change is intended to improve maintainability and reduce code duplication, but does not introduce any functional changes. The patch also includes some minor code rearrangements to accommodate the new helper function.
